title: Cargo Run Executor
description: Run a cargo subcommand against a single workspace member.

command.description: The cargo subcommand: build | test | clippy | fmt | check | bench | run.

package.description: Cargo package name (matches [package] name in the crate's Cargo.toml). Forwarded as `cargo <command> -p <package>`.

release.description: Add --release to the cargo invocation. Ignored for fmt/clippy.

features.description: Crate features to enable; forwarded as `--features a,b,c`.

args.description: Additional positional arguments appended verbatim after the cargo flags.

env.description: Extra environment variables to set on the spawned cargo process.
